name: Fuentes de Valdepero (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided blue over red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuentes de Valdepero (a fountain on blue and a tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of Fuentes de Valdepero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Fuentes de Valdepero arms — fountain on blue and tower on red
tower and crown of the arms
